conviction_note: The evidence offsets. On the negative side: Q3 brought a large rate and spread shock to a book of ~$46.7B of loans held at fair value, and this stock has sold its last three beats because the profit guide stayed flat. On the positive side: the CFO said in September that the H2 guide already assumed 1-2 hikes and that partner demand and spend were holding, and the stock sits 2% above its 52-week low with 17% of float short and short interest rising. The findings sum to -0.3; p_up 50 on a 9% absolute move gives 0. Read together, the skew (+10.5, puts bid) and the crowded short are a two-sided setup, not a lean.
bar: Q3 2026 adjusted net revenue ~$1.26B and adjusted EPS $0.17. Sources: Zacks via Yahoo, 2026-10-26 (https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/news/buy-hold-sell-sofi-stock-142100812.html: $1.26B / $0.17, EPS consensus unchanged for 60 days, ESP +2.42%); Equibles 2026-10-23 (https://equibles.com/research/sofi-technologies-sofi-q3-2026-earnings-preview-and-forecast: $1,257.2M from 18 analysts, range $1,210-1,309M; EPS $0.166 from 9 analysts); Benzinga lists $1.25-1.26B / $0.17. The sources agree within a rounding error. The company gave NO Q3 guide (the Q2 8-K defers quarterly guidance to the call). The full-year guide is adjusted net revenue $4.75-4.85B (raised 2026-07-29), adjusted EBITDA ~$1.6B, adjusted net income ~$825M and adjusted EPS ~$0.60, the last three held (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001818874/000181887426000050/a2026q2earningsrelease.htm). FY consensus is $4.87B, above the top of the guide. H1 revenue was $2.293B (Q1 $1.087B, Q2 $1.206B), so the guide midpoint implies about $1.25B a quarter in H2. Track record: SoFi beat revenue consensus by 5.5% in Q2 ($1.206B vs $1.143B) and 3.4% in Q1.
positioning_check: Short interest is 214.9M shares, 17.07% of float, with 4.2 days to cover at the 2026-09-30 settlement. That is up 13.7% from 189.0M on 2026-09-15 (MarketBeat, https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/SOFI/short-interest; Equibles carries the same 214.9M / 4.2 days, read 2026-10-26). Schaeffer's, via Gotrade 2026-10-16, puts the rise at 21% over two reporting periods. This is a crowded short. In the baseline, 25-delta skew is +10.54 vol points (puts bid), the put/call OI ratio is 0.59, the event-implied move is 8.51% (straddle 9.15%), the stock is -8.79% over 20 days, -54.9% from its 52-week high and +2.2% from its 52-week low. Two forces cut against each other here: options pay for downside, while a crowded, rising short sits at the lows into a print.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 brought a large rate and credit-spread shock to SoFi's fair-value loan book. The 2-year Treasury rose from 4.17% on 2026-06-30 to 4.85% on 2026-09-30 (+68bp; Equibles measures +74bp), the Fed hiked to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-17, and HY spreads widened from 2.75% to 3.12%, which the hedges do not cover. Exposure at June 30 was $29.7B of loans held for sale at fair value plus $16.9B held for investment at fair value. KBW (Underperform, target cut to $15 in mid-October) estimates the Q3 rate move costs more than $1B before hedges. For comparison, Q2 absorbed only a 37bp benchmark rise. Equibles models a net fair-value result of +$130M (hedges included), against a $100M downside case. The rate damage is outside what was guided only to the extent the 2-year moved by more than the 1-2 hikes the guide assumed. With the 10-year at about 5.1% in mid-October and October hike odds near 50% after the Oct 14 CPI print, Q4 marks and the guide carry the same risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-04-29 the stock fell 15.4% when the guide was held because no rate cuts were expected (secondary source). On 2026-07-29 it fell 8.9% even though Q2 absorbed a 37bp benchmark rise and still beat revenue by 5.5%. Rate headwinds have hit this name through the guide rather than through the reported revenue line, which SoFi has beaten every quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. KBW's note is public, the stock made 52-week lows on Oct 14-15 on the CPI and rates move, and skew is +10.5. What may not be priced is the exact net mark: if the HY-spread widening flows into SoFi's discount rate unhedged, the reported lending line could absorb a hit of $100M or more, which nobody has published. If the market had fully priced a large net mark, consensus revenue would have been cut. Instead it is flat at $1.26B, above the guide's implied H2 run-rate.
findings.independence: The rate path is confirmed separately by Mortgage News Daily's June 30 2-year close of 4.173% (https://www.mortgagenewsdaily.com/treasury/2yr) and the late-September level of ~4.79-4.85% (https://cryptobriefing.com/two-year-treasury-yields-climb-toward-5-percent/, 2026-09-23). The KBW estimate comes from TIKR, 2026-10-16 (https://www.tikr.com/blog/sofi-stock-hit-a-52-week-low-on-october-15-heres-what-the-october-27-report-has-to-settle). Balance-sheet exposure is from the Q2 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001818874/000181887426000054/sofi-20260630.htm). Counterweight: the CFO said on 2026-09-08 that the guide already assumes 1-2 hikes (next finding, a separate document).

findings.finding: On 2026-09-08 the CFO said at an investor conference that H2 delivery 'does not require a favorable macroeconomic change'. Specifically: the guide already assumes 1-2 rate hikes instead of the original two cuts; LPB partner demand exceeded what SoFi fulfilled in each of the last two quarters; LPB volume is expected to grow in H2 with a $3B small-business funding arrangement and closed-end second mortgages; annualized debit and credit spend of $28B had not slowed in Q3; total risk-based capital is 18.8% against a 10.5% minimum; and no equity raise is needed. Equibles separately reports the CFO guiding to a 'decent uptick' in H2 originations from the record $14.8B in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue raises have not been paid. On 2026-07-29 the FY revenue guide went to $4.75-4.85B and the stock fell 8.9%. On 2025-10-28 a raised guide was bought +5.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: These are public conference remarks, so mostly priced. The stock fell from about $16-17 in early September to $14.5 after them, so the market did not buy them. If it had, the stock would not be at 52-week lows, consensus EPS would have moved above $0.17, and skew would not be +10.5.
findings.independence: The 'decent uptick' in H2 originations is reported separately by Equibles, 2026-10-23 (https://equibles.com/research/sofi-technologies-sofi-q3-2026-earnings-preview-and-forecast), which also names the Sixth Street and Basepoint LPB agreements. Both rest on the same management remarks.

findings.finding: The bar this name actually trades on is the profit guide, and it is steep. H1 adjusted EBITDA margin ran about 30% (Q2: $357.8M, 29.7%). Holding the ~$1.6B FY EBITDA guide implies about 36% in H2. The $0.17 consensus EPS needs about $439M of Q3 EBITDA (34.4% margin), and the 22% tax rate (700bp above the original plan) already cost about $0.05 of FY EPS. The two prior prints held the profit guide while beating revenue, and the stock fell 15.4% and 8.9%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-01-30: -6.4% on the initial 2026 guide of ~$0.60 EPS. 2026-04-29: -15.4% when the guide was held. 2026-07-29: -8.9% when the revenue guide was raised but EPS/EBITDA held. Three straight sell-offs on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced, since the stock is down 44% YTD and the forward P/E is 18.8x. But consensus still sits at the guide ($0.17 Q3, $0.59-0.60 FY) and has been unchanged for 60 days. That means the street has not modelled any profit shortfall from the Q3 rate and spread move, and a fourth 'revenue up, profit held' print is not in the estimates.
findings.independence: The tax-rate cost and the profit-guide reinvestment comment ('too many large attractive growth areas to invest versus adding even more profitability') come from TIKR, 2026-10-03 (https://www.tikr.com/blog/sofi-stock-is-down-43-in-2026-should-you-buy-the-dip-before-november). The guide figures are from the company 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001818874/000181887426000050/a2026q2earningsrelease.htm). This finding shares the Equibles document with finding 1 but rests on different numbers (margin arithmetic, not marks).

findings.finding: Positioning is a crowded and growing short at the lows. Short interest is 214.9M shares, 17.07% of float, with 4.2 days to cover at 2026-09-30, up 13.7% in two weeks. The stock is 2% above its 52-week low after a -55% drawdown from $32.73. On Oct 15 it reversed +6.1% off the $13.86 low on 62.8M shares with no company news, which shows how fast it can squeeze.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2026-07-29 print (-8.9% on the day), the stock rose about 8% the next session (MarketBeat 2026-07-30), so it has reversed sharply once shorts and put buyers are crowded.
findings.why_not_priced: The skew (+10.5, puts bid) prices the downside, but not the squeeze mechanism. The short interest is visible yet still rising into the print. If the market expected a squeeze, short interest would have been falling and calls would have been bid.
findings.independence: Equibles summary, read 2026-10-26, shows the same 214.9M / 4.2 days (https://equibles.com/stocks/sofi/summary). The Oct 15 reversal is from Gotrade, 2026-10-16 (https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/sofi-sofi-stock-news-october-16-2026/).

findings.finding: SoFi has raised its deposit pricing. The base savings APY went from 3.10% (page as of 2026-05-28) to 3.30% (page as of 2026-10-20), and the new-member boost from 0.70% to 1.10% (max 4.40% vs 3.80%). Funding costs are being pushed up as the Fed hikes, against a fixed-rate personal and student loan book. Deposits are 93% of funding, $45.5B at June 30, and Q2 NIM was 5.98%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned visibly on NIM. Management guides NIM 'above 5%' and Q2 printed 5.98%, so there is room.
findings.why_not_priced: The exact date of the change within Q3 or Q4 is unknown, and no preview quantifies it. It could equally be a growth lever for deposits that fund originations, which makes it a small, ambiguous proxy.
findings.independence: The earlier rate comes from the May snapshot in the search result for the same SoFi page plus financer.com reviews (https://financer.com/personal-finance/sofis-high-yield-savings-account/). Proxy only.

findings.finding: A counterparty read on consumer credit is benign in Q3 2026. Synchrony's Q3 2026 release (reported by 2026-10-20) shows net charge-offs improving from 5.16% to 4.79% YoY, 30+ day delinquencies at 4.34% vs 4.39%, 90+ day at 2.06% vs 2.12%, and purchase volume of $49.7B growing on every platform. SoFi's own Q2 personal loan NCO was 2.62% (about 3.7% excluding late-stage delinquent loan sales).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Credit has not been the line SoFi traded on in 2026. Improving Q2 NCOs (3.03% to 2.62%) did not stop a -8.9% day.
findings.why_not_priced: Card-issuer credit is a proxy for SoFi's prime personal-loan book. The market's worry on SoFi is rates and capital, not credit (KBW says so explicitly), so this mostly removes a tail rather than adding upside.
findings.independence: This is a secondary AI-generated summary of Synchrony's release. Proxy, not a SoFi number.

findings.why_not_priced: Already inside the guide and public, so near zero. It would only matter through a 2027 comment.
findings.independence: CFO's 2026-09-08 remarks (https://www.dailypolitical.com/?p=10496726) call it a transition year.

baseline_tension: The rates and profit-guide findings agree with the +10.5 put skew and the -8.8% 20-day run-up. The crowded, rising short at the 52-week low and the CFO's macro-proof H2 framing cut against them. Net, the evidence does not beat the skew, so the lean stays at 50 and the size stays on the option-implied move.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 + rule 6: the rates/fair-value negative is shrunk from -1.5 to -1.0, because short interest is crowded (17% of float, rising) and the CFO said the guide already assumes 1-2 hikes, which puts part of the move inside guidance.
Rule 1: the CFO's positive H2 remarks are shrunk from +1.0 to +0.7, because this name has sold three consecutive revenue beats and raises.
Rule 7: the profit-guide negative is shrunk from -1.0 to -0.8 for the crowded short; the reaction line itself is unchanged.
Rule 6: the Synchrony credit proxy is trimmed from +0.3 to +0.2 and the tech-platform item from -0.2 to -0.1, both inside the guide.
Rule 3: positioning and skew offset in baseline_tension, so p_up moves from 49 to 50 and expected_move goes from -0.18 to 0.
Positioning (+1.0) and deposit APY (-0.3) are unchanged.
